workflows.yaml:
version: '1'
name: High-Value Daily Aggregate Triage
description: >
  Aggregates total event.amount per account.name per day in fraud-workshop*
  using ES|QL, passes each account whose daily total is >= 10000 to AI
  classification, opens a Kibana case for high/critical risk, and emails
  the fraud team.
enabled: true
tags:
  - fraud
  - high-value
  - aggregate
  - triage
  - automation

consts:
  triage_email: email@notifications.com

triggers:
  - type: manual

steps:
  - name: fetch_daily_account_totals
    type: elasticsearch.esql.query
    with:
      # KEEP fixes column order to [account_name, day, daily_total].
      # The ES|QL step returns { columns, values } (NOT { hits }).
      # values is an array of rows; each row is an array in column order,
      # accessed positionally in Liquid below: [0]=account_name, [1]=day, [2]=daily_total.
      query: FROM fraud-workshop* | WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 45 days | EVAL day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp) | STATS daily_total = SUM(event.amount) BY account_name = account.name, day | WHERE daily_total >= 10000 | KEEP account_name, day, daily_total | SORT daily_total DESC | LIMIT 10
      format: json

  - name: check_accounts_found
    type: if
    # condition is KQL, NOT Liquid. KQL has no "| length" filter.
    # ": *" tests that the field exists / is non-empty.
    condition: "steps.fetch_daily_account_totals.output.values: *"
    steps:
      - name: process_each_account
        type: foreach
        foreach: "{{ steps.fetch_daily_account_totals.output.values }}"
        steps:
          - name: classify_risk
            type: ai.classify
            connector-id: openai-connector
            with:
              input: "Account: {{ foreach.item[0] }}, Day: {{ foreach.item[1] }}, Daily total: {{ foreach.item[2] }}"
              categories:
                - "critical"
                - "high"
                - "medium"
                - "low"
              instructions: "You are a financial fraud analyst. Classify the risk of this account's aggregated daily transaction total. Respond with exactly one of the lowercase category labels. Use critical for daily totals over 50000. Use high for daily totals over 25000. Use medium for daily totals over 10000 that may indicate structuring across multiple smaller transactions. Use low for explainable high-value daily activity. A high daily total made up of many transactions just under reporting thresholds is a strong structuring/smurfing signal."
              includeRationale: true
              fallbackCategory: "medium"

          - name: create_case_for_high_risk
            type: if
            condition: "steps.classify_risk.output.category: (critical or high or CRITICAL or HIGH)"
            steps:
              - name: open_case
                type: cases.createCase
                with:
                  title: "High-Value Daily Total [{{ steps.classify_risk.output.category | upcase }}] {{ foreach.item[0] }} - ${{ foreach.item[2] }}"
                  description: "## High-Value Daily Aggregate Alert\n\n**Account Holder:** {{ foreach.item[0] }}\n**Day:** {{ foreach.item[1] }}\n**Daily Total:** ${{ foreach.item[2] }}\n**Risk Level:** {{ steps.classify_risk.output.category }}\n\n### AI Risk Assessment\n{{ steps.classify_risk.output.rationale }}"
                  tags:
                    - fraud
                    - high-value
                    - aggregate
                    - automated-triage
                    - "{{ steps.classify_risk.output.category }}"
                  owner: securitySolution
                  severity: high
                  settings:
                    syncAlerts: false

#          - name: send_email_for_high_risk
#            type: if
#            condition: "steps.classify_risk.output.category: (critical or high or CRITICAL or HIGH)"
#            steps:
#              - name: notify_fraud_team
#                type: email
#                connector-id: elastic-cloud-email
#                with:
#                  to:
#                    - "{{ consts.triage_email }}"
#                  subject: "[{{ steps.classify_risk.output.category | upcase }} RISK] Daily Total - {{ foreach.item[0] }} - ${{ foreach.item[2] }}"
#                  message: "An account's aggregated daily transaction total has been automatically triaged.\n\nAccount Holder: {{ foreach.item[0] }}\nDay: {{ foreach.item[1] }}\nDaily Total: ${{ foreach.item[2] }}\nRisk Level: {{ steps.classify_risk.output.category }}\n\nAI Risk Assessment:\n{{ steps.classify_risk.output.rationale }}\n\nA case has been created in Kibana for further investigation."
    else:
      - name: log_no_accounts
        type: console
        with:
          message: "No accounts with a daily SUM(event.amount) >= 10000 found in fraud-workshop* in the last 45 days."
